answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 51628 Country: India Title: about zakat Question: I am employee in a company and 1 year has passed on my amount 1 lakh. Am I able to pay zakah on it? Kindly reply as soon as possible. Answer ID: 51628 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 919/735/B=06/1435) Yes, it is wajib for you to pay the fortieth part of one lakh i.e. 2500 as zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
